mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% MoM and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and starts to rise, it signals the beginning of a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and starts to rise, but SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases, but SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 MoM and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive but below 2% YoY, coupled with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5%), it signals a mature economic expansion phase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth 0-2% YoY and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
